mechanism: Amphotericin B causes nephrotoxicity and electrolyte disturbances (hypokalemia, hypomagnesemia) which may alter lamotrigine metabolism and increase seizure risk or lamotrigine toxicity.
action: Monitor renal function, electrolytes, and lamotrigine levels closely; maintain adequate hydration and consider liposomal formulation of amphotericin B if possible to minimize nephrotoxicity.
